lines.en: label wakanadate1:
I tap on Wakana’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了 Wakana 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: I don’t really understand how things got to this point...but here we are.
lines.zh: 我不太明白事情怎么会走到这一步……但我们就这样了。

lines.en: Granted, I doubt she’ll answer in the first place. But at least it’s worth a shot.
lines.zh: 当然，我怀疑她根本不会接。但至少值得一试。

lines.en: Worse comes to worst, I can always just...go find someone else inherently sad to spend time with.
lines.zh: 最坏的情况，我也总能……去找另一个骨子里就丧的人一起打发时间。

lines.en: That sure sounds like a lot of fun.
lines.zh: 听起来可真有意思。

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: : I had a feeling you were going to answer the phone like that.
lines.zh: : 我就有种预感你会这样接电话。

lines.en: : Oh. It’s you.
lines.zh: : 哦。是你啊。

lines.en: : So, that wasn’t a personalized greeting and is just the way you answer the phone for everyone?
lines.zh: : 所以那不是专门给我的问候，你对谁都这么接？

lines.en: : What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你想干嘛？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea what time it is?
lines.zh: : 你知道现在几点吗？

lines.en: : Early. Let’s hang out.
lines.zh: : 很早。我们出去玩吧。

lines.en: : Okay.
: Now, before you say no, let me give you a list of the pros when it comes to spending time with me. I-
lines.zh: : 现在，在你拒绝之前，让我先列一列跟我待在一起的好处。我——

lines.en: : I said okay.
lines.zh: : 我说好。

lines.en: : Are you truly this incapable of simply listening to someone when they speak?
lines.zh: : 你是真的没法好好听人把话说完吗？

lines.en: : Wait, really? I don’t even have to convince you?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？我都不用说服你？

lines.en: : I’m in my office. Come here.
lines.zh: : 我在办公室。过来。

lines.en: : Your office? Like, at[school]?
lines.zh: : 你办公室？就是[school]里那个？

lines.en: : Correct. Now, goodbye.
lines.zh: : 对。行了，再见。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: Why is Wakana at[school] on the weekend?
lines.zh: Wakana 周末为什么会在[school]？

lines.en: And why this early?
lines.zh: 还这么早？

lines.en: Am I really going to spend the little free time I have going back to the same place I’m forced to “teach” five days out of every week?
lines.zh: 我那点少得可怜的空闲时间，真的要花在那个每周被迫「教书」五天的地方吗？

lines.en: scene black
Of course I am- because there is an attractive girl there who wants to see me.
lines.zh: 当然要去——因为那儿有个想见我的漂亮姑娘。

lines.en: Or, at the very least, is {i}okay{/i} with seeing me.
lines.zh: 或者，至少不{i}介意{/i}见我。

lines.en: And also has a girlfriend who could break my arm in five seconds if she wanted to.
lines.zh: 而且她还有个女朋友，只要她愿意，五秒就能掰断我的胳膊。

lines.en: I should probably be careful with what I say to Wakana this morning.
lines.zh: 今天早上我跟 Wakana 说话大概该小心点。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit1
: Hey, Wakana. You’re looking awfully beautiful this morning.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Wakana。你今天早上看起来真美。

lines.en: I fail immediately.
lines.zh: 我瞬间就失败了。

lines.en: : Thank you. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我很领情。

lines.en: : I'm sorry. I know I-
lines.zh: : 对不起。我知道我——

lines.en: : I said...{i}I appreciate that{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我说……我{i}很领情{/i}。

lines.en: : Wait, you do?
lines.zh: : 等等，你真的？

lines.en: : Do you believe me to be so dead inside that I’m incapable of receiving a compliment?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我已经死到连一句夸奖都收不下了吗？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有点，是啊。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit2
: Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 也算合理。

lines.en: : Any more than that would have been entirely unprofessional and unwarranted, though.
lines.zh: : 不过再多说一点就完全不合职业规范，也没道理了。

lines.en: : Especially given that my significant other could snap your arm like a toothpick in less than ten seconds.
lines.zh: : 尤其是我的另一半能在不到十秒内把你的胳膊像牙签一样折断。

lines.en: : Less than five, actually. I already confirmed this in my thoughts a little bit earlier.
lines.zh: : 其实是不到五秒。我刚才在心里已经确认过了。

lines.en: : How exciting.
lines.zh: : 真让人兴奋。

lines.en: : Anyway, thank you for coming here to do my bidding.
lines.zh: : 总之，谢谢你过来听我差遣。

lines.en: : Your...what?
lines.zh: : 你的……什么？

lines.en: : My bidding.
lines.zh: : 听我差遣。

lines.en: : Is this a sexual thing?
lines.zh: : 这是性方面的意思吗？

lines.en: : You’ve been spending too much time with that Nagasawa girl.
lines.zh: : 你跟那个长泽家的丫头待太久了。

lines.en: : Hey, your favorite student of mine is no saint either.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你最喜欢的那位我的学生也不是什么圣人。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit3
: You leave Miyamura out of this. She’s as pure as the whitest snow.
lines.zh: : 你别把宫村扯进来。她白得像最白的雪。

lines.en: : Wakana, she works in a porn shop.
lines.zh: : Wakana，她在色情用品店上班。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit4
: Nonsense. The girl her age who works at the local porn shop does not wear glasses. They are entirely different people.
lines.zh: : 胡说。在本地那家色情用品店打工的同龄女孩不戴眼镜。她们完全是两个人。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were a customer there.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你还是那儿的顾客。

lines.en: : I’m in a lesbian relationship with a girl who likes being handcuffed. Of course I am a customer there.
lines.zh: : 我正跟一个喜欢被铐起来的女孩谈着同性恋爱。我当然是那儿的顾客。

lines.en: : Now, can we please move this conversation away from territory that should remain completely unknown to one another as coworkers?
lines.zh: : 现在，能不能请把话题从这块作为同事本该完全不知道的领域上挪开？

lines.en: : I only agreed to seeing you today as I’m behind on grading papers and need your assistance.
lines.zh: : 我答应今天见你，是因为我卷子改不完，需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : That is something you should have probably informed me of beforehand.
lines.zh: : 这事你本该提前告诉我的。

lines.en: : And risk you not coming to help? Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 然后冒着你不来帮忙的风险？绝对不行。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit5
: Now, take these and make yourself useful.
lines.zh: : 拿着这些，去干点有用的事。

lines.en: : You know, maybe the reason you always want to die is because you spend so much time-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许你总想死的原因就是你花了太多时间——

lines.en: : Doing my job?
lines.zh: : 干我的工作？

lines.en: : Being anti-fun.
lines.zh: : 反娱乐。

lines.en: : I don’t have time for fun. I’m responsible for the education of a multitude of [young_girls] who may or may not wind up turning into more Nodoka Nagasawas as they get older.
lines.zh: : 我没时间娱乐。我要负责一大群[young_girls]的教育，她们长大后说不定会变成更多的长泽 Nodoka。

lines.en: : For the sake of our future generations, I must repeatedly kill myself on a daily basis.
lines.zh: : 为了我们的下一代，我必须每天反复把自己弄死一次。

lines.en: : This is the road I must take.
lines.zh: : 这条路我必须走。

lines.en: : Some might even say the {i}road less traveled by.{/i}
lines.zh: : 甚至有人说，这是条{i}少有人走的路{/i}。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit6
: Don’t try to appeal to me through overrated literary references. Frost was a hack.
lines.zh: : 别拿那些被高估的文学典故来讨好我。弗罗斯特就是个糊弄事的。

lines.en: : Why spend so much time writing about {i}nature{/i} of all things when essentially every other topic known to man is both far more interesting and far more...not fucking stupid.
lines.zh: : 人类已知的话题里，几乎随便哪个都比它有趣、也都比它……不那他妈的蠢，他干嘛要花那么多时间写{i}大自然{/i}？

lines.en: : The outside world is nothing but a hellish landscape even in the coldest of winters and I will not sit idly by as you quote a man who would probably fuck a tree if given the opportunity.
lines.zh: : 外面的世界就算在最冷的冬天也不过是一片地狱般的景象，我可不会干坐着听你引用一个有机会大概会去操树的人。

lines.en: : You...feel pretty strongly about this, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你……对这事感触很深啊？

lines.en: : Are you going to help me grade these tests or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底要不要帮我改这些卷子？

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit7
: This is a pretty nice office you’ve got here, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 你这办公室挺不错的，Wakana。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking god. Why do you even work here?
lines.zh: : 我操他妈的。你到底为什么在这儿工作？

lines.en: : I think it’s a little smaller than mine overall, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得总体上比我的还小一点。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit8

: Yes. It’s almost as if the Japanese work force values male employees more than it does female ones- even when said males aimlessly wander the halls, sodomizing students with their eyes all day long.
lines.zh: : 是啊。就好像日本的职场重视男员工胜过女员工——哪怕那些男的整天在走廊里瞎晃、用眼睛强奸学生。

lines.en: : Hey. Don’t lump all males in with me. I’m a special exception.
lines.zh: : 嘿。别把所有男的都跟我归一类。我是特例。

lines.en: : You sure are.
lines.zh: : 你确实是。

lines.en: : Really, though. You should stop being so serious all the time.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。你别老是这么严肃。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit9
: I think you may be misinterpreting how much “time” we have left.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能误会了我们剩下多少「时间」。

lines.en: : Every day, we slip further and further into a pit of despair that even the most seasoned of climbers will one day struggle to find their way out of.
lines.zh: : 每一天，我们都在往一个绝望的深坑里越滑越深，深到连最有经验的攀爬者有朝一日都难以找到出路。

lines.en: : So you’re trying to get out by just subjecting yourself to {i}more{/i} despair?
lines.zh: : 所以你是想靠让自己承受{i}更{/i}多绝望来爬出去？

lines.en: : What’s the strategy here?
lines.zh: : 这算什么策略？

lines.en: : The strategy is that you mind your own fucking business.
lines.zh: : 策略就是你去操你他妈自己的事。

lines.en: : Oh, I know- why don't we talk a little more about poetry?
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道了——我们何不多聊点诗？

lines.en: : You? The person who quoted the fucking “Road Not Taken?”
lines.zh: : 你？那个引用了那首操蛋的《未选择的路》的人？

lines.en: : What’s next? Plums?
lines.zh: : 下一个是什么？李子？

lines.en: : I just want to spend some time with a Wakana Watabe who isn’t killing herself over a job she doesn’t even like.
lines.zh: : 我只是想跟一个不会为了一份自己根本不喜欢的工作把自己弄死的渡部 Wakana 待一会儿。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit10
: It’s not as if I don’t {i}like{/i} it. I just...don’t like it?
lines.zh: : 也不是说我不{i}喜欢{/i}。我只是……不喜欢？

lines.en: : Deep.
lines.zh: : 深刻。

lines.en: : What I mean to say is that it’s as if there’s no true payoff anymore.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，好像已经没有真正的回报了。

lines.en: : You’re not a teacher, so you likely won’t understand, but the most satisfying part of this job is watching the flowers you've cultivated finally being plucked and stuck into vases all over Japan.
lines.zh: : 你不是老师，大概不会懂，但这行最让人满足的部分，是看着自己培育的花终于被摘下来，插进全日本各地的花瓶里。

lines.en: : The sense of accomplishment in knowing that you were able to impact the lives of others in some form.
lines.zh: : 那种知道自己以某种形式影响了别人人生的成就感。

lines.en: : And...for some reason-
lines.zh: : 然后……不知为什么——

lines.en: : It feels as if that “payoff” is further away than ever before.
lines.zh: : 感觉那份「回报」比以往任何时候都更远。

lines.en: From out of Wakana’s mouth crawls an invisible spider in the form of a thought.
lines.zh: 一只无形的蜘蛛以念头的形态从 Wakana 嘴里爬出来。

lines.en: It quickly makes its way over to me and sinks its fangs into my skin, injecting me with the question of what effect the distortion of time has in scenarios like this.
lines.zh: 它迅速爬到我身上，把毒牙扎进我的皮肤，往我体内注入一个问题：在这种情境下，时间的扭曲会产生什么影响。

lines.en: If Wakana’s memories carry over from one reset to the next, the same way everyone else’s seem to-
lines.zh: 如果 Wakana 的记忆像其他人那样，从一次重置延续到下一次——

lines.en: And her outlook on her profession is centered entirely around the relief that is provided once a[school] year comes to an end-
lines.zh: 而她对自己职业的看法，又完全围绕着学年结束时能得到的解脱——

lines.en: Wouldn’t something like this put her into limbo?
lines.zh: 那这种事不是会把她悬在半空吗？

lines.en: Endlessly chasing after a goal that’s impossible to obtain, yet clinging onto the belief that it’s just around the corner.
lines.zh: 无休止地追逐一个不可能达成的目标，却死抱着「它就在拐角处」的信念。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit11
: What’s this? {i}You{/i}, of all people, turning silent?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？{i}你{/i}居然沉默了？

lines.en: : Don’t tell me that...you were able to understand what I was saying after all?
lines.zh: : 别告诉我……你其实听懂我说的话了？

lines.en: : Do you have a favorite poet, Wakana?
lines.zh: : Wakana，你有喜欢的诗人吗？

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit12
: You’re still going on about that?
lines.zh: : 你还在纠结这个？

lines.en: : Just help me grade my fucking tests so we can get out of this place.
lines.zh: : 帮我改掉那些操蛋的卷子，我们好离开这地方。

lines.en: : I just want to know what sorts of things inspire {i}you{/i}- a person who, somehow or another, still gets up in the morning to try and inspire others.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，是什么样的东西在激励{i}你{/i}——一个不知怎么每天早上还能爬起来、去试着激励别人的人。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit13
: Hah...
: You can probably tell just by looking at me.
lines.zh: : 你大概看我一眼就知道了。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit14
: {i}But when within thy wave she looks-\nWhich glistens then, and trembles-{/i}
lines.zh:
: {i}但当她在你的波心顾盼——
它便闪烁，又战栗——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why, then, the prettiest of brooks\nHer worshipper resembles;{/i}
lines.zh:
: {i}于是，最秀美的小溪
恰似她的崇拜者；{/i}

lines.en: : {i}For in his heart, as in thy stream,\nHer image deeply lies-{/i}
lines.zh:
: {i}因在他心底，如在你流中，
她的影像深藏——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}His heart which trembles at the beam\nOf her soul-searching eyes.{/i}
lines.zh:
: {i}他的心在她的明眸
那洞察灵魂的光芒下战栗。{/i}

lines.en: : Edgar Allan Poe.
lines.zh: : 埃德加·爱伦·坡。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit15
: Did you actually know that one? Or was it just my choice of clothing after all?
lines.zh: : 你是真的知道这首？还是说其实只是因为我的穿着？

lines.en: : I knew it.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : Just because I vehemently refuse to do my job doesn’t mean I’m not actually smart.
lines.zh: : 我坚决拒绝干我的活，不代表我真的不聪明。

lines.en: : Do you believe there to be a correlation between one’s level of intellect and how many lines of poetry they’ve memorized?
lines.zh: : 你觉得一个人的智力水平跟他背了多少行诗有关系？

lines.en: : Not really. But I know stuff and knowing stuff makes me cool.
lines.zh: : 不算有。但我知道东西，知道东西让我很酷。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit16
: Hm.
: Are you impressed? Have I finally convinced you to take a break from doing your job on your day off?
lines.zh: : 你被打动了吗？我终于说服你在休息日放下工作喘口气了？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 完全没有。

lines.en: : Though, I suppose it wouldn’t hurt to spare five minutes or so.
lines.zh: : 不过，我想腾出个五分钟左右也不碍事。

lines.en: scene black
Wakana makes her way over to a bookshelf on the side of the room and drags her finger across a number of what appear to be anthologies.
lines.zh: Wakana 走到房间一侧的书架前，指尖划过一排看起来是诗选的书脊。

lines.en: She eventually stops on one and removes it from the shelf, leaning up against it and popping the book open as if she’s already memorized where a certain poem is located.
lines.zh: 她最终停在某一本上，把它抽下来，倚着书架把书翻开，那架势像早就记住了某首诗的位置。

lines.en: Either that or she’s just reading a random poem she opened to- but I'd like to believe that there was at least some level of tact or calculation to it.
lines.zh: 要么就是她只是在读随手翻到的某首诗——但我宁愿相信这多少有点心思和算计。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit17
: {i}She walks in beauty, like the night\nOf cloudless climes and starry skies;{/i}
lines.zh:
: {i}她走在美的光影里，像夜晚
无云的气候、繁星的天空；{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And all that’s best of dark and bright\nMeet in her aspect and her eyes;{/i}
lines.zh:
: {i}明与暗的最好的一切
都汇聚在她的容颜与眼眸；{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Thus mellowed to that tender light\nWhich heaven to gaudy day denies.{/i}
lines.zh:
: {i}于是被调和成那种柔光，
是俗艳的白昼从天堂得不到的。{/i}

lines.en: : That’s not Poe. Isn’t that-
lines.zh: : 这不是坡。这不是——

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit18
: Lord Byron.
lines.zh: : 拜伦勋爵。

lines.en: : You asked me for a favorite poet, to which the answer was Poe.
lines.zh: : 你问我最喜欢的诗人，答案是坡。

lines.en: : But if I were to choose a favorite poem, it would be this one.
lines.zh: : 但如果要选最喜欢的一首诗，那就是这首。

lines.en: : Why this one?
lines.zh: : 为什么是这首？

lines.en: : The answer is quite embarrassing, so I’d rather not say.
lines.zh: : 答案相当难为情，所以我不想说。

lines.en: : Why even read it in the first place then? We're supposed to be using this opportunity to deepen our relationship.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还要读它？我们本该利用这个机会加深关系的。

lines.en: : Why, I believe we just did.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我觉得我们刚刚已经加深了。

lines.en: : Now-
lines.zh: : 现在——

lines.en: : Back to work.
lines.zh: : 回去干活。

lines.en: scene black
As quickly as she had found the book and thus the poem, she slides it back into place and makes her way over to her desk.
lines.zh: 她找到书、找到诗有多快，把它插回原位就有多快，然后走回自己的办公桌。

lines.en: Without even drawing a breath, she once again holds out a file containing a bunch of tests and...expects me to know what to do with them.
lines.zh: 她连气都没喘一口，就又举起一叠卷子……指望我知道该怎么处理。

lines.en: scene wakanafirstvisit5
: Playtime is over. Either help me or get out.
lines.zh: : 玩够了。要么帮忙，要么滚。

lines.en: : You are an entirely unexciting friend to have, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 你这个人当朋友真是一点意思都没有，Wakana。

lines.en: : And you are proving to be an entirely useless one.
lines.zh: : 而你正证明自己是个完全没用的朋友。

lines.en: : Though, I can’t say I’m at all surprised.
lines.zh: : 不过，我得说，我一点都不意外。

lines.en: : Even if you do have surprisingly decent taste in poetry apart from that fucking Robert Frost guy.
lines.zh: : 尽管除了那个操蛋的罗伯特·弗罗斯特，你在诗上的品味意外地不错。

lines.en: : What in the world did Robert Frost do to you to make you hate him so much?
lines.zh: : 罗伯特·弗罗斯特到底对你做了什么，让你这么恨他？

lines.en: : Existed.
lines.zh: : 存在过。

lines.en: : Now, take these fucking tests. My arm is getting tired.
lines.zh: : 现在，拿着这些操蛋的卷子。我胳膊累了。

lines.en: scene black
Surprisingly enough, I {i}do{/i} take the tests from Wakana.
lines.zh: 出乎意料的是，我{i}真的{/i}从 Wakana 手里接过了卷子。

lines.en: However, I’m only able to grade three of them before getting bored and deciding to head home.
lines.zh: 不过我只改了三份就腻了，决定回家。

lines.en: I also just mindlessly marked a few of them off instead of actually paying attention to them, so I apologize in advance to anyone who may have failed because of me.
lines.zh: 而且我也只是漫不经心地随手勾了几道，根本没认真看，所以提前向任何可能因为我不及格的人道歉。

lines.en: But I’d also like to thank those people for allowing me to get a little closer to Wakana- something I didn’t really ever think I’d be able to do.
lines.zh: 不过我也想谢谢这些人——是他们让我离 Wakana 更近了一点，而这本来是我真没想到自己能做到的事。

lines.en: $ wakanadate1 = True
$ wakana_love += 1
{i}Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Wakana 的好感度提升到了 [wakana_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
